scheme_name: Financial Assistance For Aids And Appliances For Disabled Persons
other_conditions: Applicant must be an Indian citizen and a permanent resident of Maharashtra
Applicant must be a Person with Disability (e.g., Visually Handicapped, Low Vision, Hearing Impaired, Orthopedically Handicapped) with a disability percentage of 40% or above
Monthly income must be less than ₹1,500 for 100% assistance or between ₹1,500 and ₹2,000 for 50% assistance
benefits_summary: Provides financial assistance for aids and appliances such as hearing aids, crutches, wheelchairs, and tape recorders up to specified cost limits.
documents_required: Hard copy of the application form
